name: country tax-form chips check in two columns
looks: Two columns of small flag-and-label chips build down the frame under a headline, each chip getting a checkmark as it lands. Every chip stays at full brightness once checked, so the list reads as a tally completing rather than a single line being highlighted.
build: One DOM row per chip, grouped into two columns; each fades/slides in (opacity 0->1, y 8px->0, power2.out, ~0.3s) on its own beat with a checkmark icon popping in 0.1s after the row lands. Unlike a dimming list stack, every row keeps full contrast once checked, read as a tally.
sound: A soft tick per chip landing, a slightly brighter chime per checkmark, building in density as columns fill.
prompt: Build a two-column list of small labelled chips (a flag or icon plus a short label) under a headline, each one landing in turn and getting a checkmark the instant it arrives, every chip staying fully bright once checked so the whole thing reads as a completing tally.
